title: Digital Downloads: Sell Files and Deliver Them Safely | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A file you sell can be copied, so you cannot leave it at a public address. The CrestApps Digital Downloads module keeps your files private, delivers them to buyers after they pay through links that expire and can be used a set number of times, and lets you take a link back, give downloads back, or send a buyer their link again.

In this video:
• Why digital downloads, and how upload, payment and download fit together
• Setting up a digital product: files and limits
• The site-wide limits under Settings
• What buyers see: the email, their account, their order and the download page
• Managing a buyer's downloads: take back, give back, the buyer's link
• Use cases
